verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair axis for an IaC platform. The pack shows a Cloud REST API reference page and a `pulumi api` CLI command for calling endpoints. Neither is documented as an interactive explorer with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so the CLI call path is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
